candidate_windows.window_text: We conducted the experiments using Hugging Face's Transformers package² on two NVIDIA A6000 GPUs (40GB RAM each, CUDA 11.8). For inference, we used top- $p$ sampling $( p = 0 . 9 )$ and a temperature of O.1 to balance diversity and coherence. Each model required approximately 3-4 hours to complete all tasks. All experiments were repeated three times. The average values of the three repetitions were reported.
